document_summary: Dr. Mahmoud Sabahi leads a sustained study of Sura 74. The opening questions the traditional identification of the covered or hidden figure with Muhammad and applies the call to warn more broadly. The portrait of a wealthy rejecter leads into Sabahi's account of the Iranian Revolution, emigration, Masjid Tucson, contentment, and spiritual wealth. Rashad interprets cleansing the cover as removing doubts and Quran 9:128–129. Long linguistic digressions concern ummi, alaq, the shape of Earth, and invented meanings. Quran 74:30–31 is treated as a manifesto for the number nineteen. Sabahi describes his gradual movement toward certainty, warns against weak overextended arguments, and the group discusses judging, suspicion, age forty, reasons for Hell, intercession, and future hypocrites.

Then, from these instructions, the first part, if you look at it, it's all in present tense. It's like the instructions telling him what to do and what not to do. And then, from 12 on, it starts with, [74:12] I provided him with lots of money. I provided these, which is referring I believe to the disbeliever, those individuals that God is saying that I'll deal with them. [74:12] I provided him with lots of money. [74:13] And children to behold. [74:14] I made everything easy for him. [74:15] Yet, he is greedy for more. [74:16] He stubbornly refused to accept these proofs.
